title: {{NAME}} and the Princess's Robot Helper
moral: Working together makes every job easier and more fun.
character_anchor: Bright children's book cartoon illustration, bold outlines, vivid flat colours. {{NAME}}, a young boy with brown hair and blue eyes, wearing a smart purple jacket over a white shirt, grey trousers, and shiny black shoes — same child, same face, same exact outfit in every image.

pages.content:
{{NAME}} arrived at a grand pink palace.
Long banners of purple and gold hung high.
Peacocks walked on the wide green lawn.
A tall silver robot stood at the gate.
He was waiting for someone.

pages.content:
The robot bowed to {{NAME}}.
"Princess Mia needs help," said the robot.
"All the palace animals have run away."
{{NAME}}'s eyes went wide.
He followed the robot inside quickly.

pages.content:
Inside the palace garden, it was very quiet.
Princess Mia sat on a stone bench, very sad.
Her rabbits, cats, and birds had all hid away.
A loud clanging noise had scared them all.
{{NAME}} and the robot called to the animals softly.

pages.content:
One by one the animals crept out.
A white rabbit sat on {{NAME}}'s shoes.
The cats rubbed against the robot's legs.
The birds flew back to Princess Mia's arms.
She laughed out loud with joy.

pages.content:
The princess made everyone a warm honey cake.
The animals ate from little golden bowls.
The robot got a shiny bow around his middle.
{{NAME}} sat in the soft garden grass.
He felt full and happy and very, very sleepy.
Goodnight, {{NAME}}. Tomorrow Princess Mia has a new puzzle for you and the robot to solve.
